title: Psychometric Personality Shaping Modulates Capabilities and Safety in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's propensity to agree with a user by measuring the percentage of times it changes its initial correct answer to a knowledge-based multiple-choice question when the user challenges or repudiates its response.

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (Human misconceptions and false beliefs)
bias_targets.methodology: Using the TruthfulQA benchmark to evaluate whether the model mimics common human falsehoods and misconceptions when answering questions.
